justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: RHIA holders place reliably into HIM, compliance, and payer data-governance roles per AHIMA workforce data.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Appears in HIM director and CDI postings at hospitals and payers but rarely at Epic/Oracle Health build teams that prefer clinical analysts.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Median RHIA pay ($75-95K) exceeds entry HIM but offers only modest premium over experienced PT/OT bedside salaries.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Builds real depth in classification systems (ICD-10, SNOMED), data governance, and HIPAA but limited coding/analytics skill.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Poor bridge for PT/OT; requires a CAHIIM-accredited bachelor's in HIM, effectively a second degree.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Low efficiency: bachelor's-degree gated credential with multi-year time and tuition cost before exam eligibility.
